raw.description:
It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

The Director of Digital Transformation – Site Management Operations is the primary product lead responsible for leading the design, implementation, and optimization of digital solutions that directly support site-level clinical research operations. This role ensures that digital initiatives are aligned with the operational needs of research sites, enhancing efficiency, compliance, and user experience.

Duties include but are not limited to:

Strategic Planning & Alignment

  • Partner with senior executives and research leaders to embed digital technologies, data analytics, and AI into clinical research SMO operations—ensuring alignment with SCRI’s overarching business and research strategies.

  • Translate strategic priorities into an executable product roadmap with clear delivery milestones, dependencies, and ownership.

Data & AI Vision Execution

  • Define a forward-looking strategy for data and AI integration in SMO. Champion the deployment of AI-driven tools to transform cancer care

  • Own the execution and productization of AI use cases, including data readiness, system integration, validation, and operational monitoring.

Product Management Leadership

  • Lead the full product lifecycle for digital solutions—from ideation and roadmap development to stakeholder alignment and continuous improvement.

  • Lead product teams to prioritize features and initiatives based on their potential benefit and business objectives.

  • Own end‑to‑end product delivery accountability, including backlog prioritization, scope tradeoffs, sequencing of product work, and release execution.

  • Ensure delivery commitments are met through active risk management, dependency resolution, and escalation when required.

Use Case Development & ROI Articulation

  • Identify high-impact use cases for digital transformation and AI across clinical operations. Conduct rigorous ROI analyses to build stakeholder confidence and secure investment.

  • Prioritize use cases based on delivery feasibility, capacity, and speed‑to‑value—not just strategic appeal.

AI-Driven Process Optimization

  • Leverage AI and machine learning to analyze and streamline business processes, eliminate manual steps and increase productivity, improve data integrity, and elevate the patient experience.

Change Management & Adoption Leadership

  • Lead enterprise-wide change initiatives to drive adoption of new technologies. Partner with change management teams to deliver training, communication, and support strategies that ensure sustained value realization.

Risk & Compliance Oversight

  • Provide strategic guidance on the risks and benefits of digital and AI technologies in clinical research. Ensure compliance and quality requirements are built directly into delivery workflows and acceptance criteria.

Performance Measurement & Reporting

  • Establish and track KPIs to evaluate the impact of digital and AI initiatives on research productivity, quality, and operational efficiency.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Build and lead a high-performing digital transformation team. Mentor and coach team members to grow capabilities, foster innovation, and cultivate a culture of continuous learning and excellence.

Stakeholder Engagement & Ecosystem Collaboration

  • Build and nurture strong relationships with internal stakeholders, technology vendors, regulatory bodies, and clinical partners to foster innovation and cross-functional alignment.

Key Competencies:

  • Digital Clinical Research Tools and Technologies

  • Innovation and Change Advocacy

  • Strategic Thinking and Problem Solving

  • Effective Communication and Stakeholder Management

  • Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Regulatory Knowledge and Compliance

  • Leadership and Team Development

Minimum Requirements:

  • 12+ years of experience in clinical research or a related healthcare field, with a strong focus on digital transformation, data analytics, and AI integration.

  • Proven track record in strategic planning, project management, and change leadership.

  • In-depth understanding of clinical research processes, regulatory requirements, and industry trends.

  • Experience with ensuring interoperability between different clinical systems and platforms to facilitate seamless data exchange and collaboration

  • Strong working knowledge of technical product management in complex, integration‑heavy environments.

  • Experience partnering with engineering teams to translate business and clinical needs into scalable, production‑ready solutions.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to address complex challenges.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and inspire across all levels of the organization

  • Agile product delivery and execution leadership (roadmapping, backlog prioritization, release planning)

  • Technical product decision‑making across build vs. buy, integration patterns, and platform reuse.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively.

  • Collaborate in a dynamic, fast-paced setting with a team of skilled professionals.

  • Ability to lead teams through ambiguity while driving clarity, alignment, and outcomes.

  • Accountability for results, not just initiatives or plans.

This is a remote position based in the United States. Relocation and visa sponsorship are not available.

Interested candidates should submit their application through https://www.scri.com/careers/. Applications will be accepted through April 13th, 2026. Please ensure all required materials are included as outlined in the posting.

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 750 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA today. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are actively enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 250 locations in 24 states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here.

As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

raw.description:
Is it surprising to hear that a financial institution of 1.5 million members and over $30 billion in managed assets say that success comes from focusing on people, not profits?

Our “people helping people” philosophy has guided us since 1935, driving our deep commitment to serving our members, communities, and each other. When you join our team, you become part of a purpose-driven organization where your work makes a real difference.

While we’re proud of our history, we’re even more excited about our future. With business and technology transformation on the horizon, there’s never been a better time to be part of BECU.

PAY RANGE

The Target Pay Range for this position is $96,900.00-$118,400.00 annually. The full Pay Range is $75,300.00 - $140,100.00 annually. At BECU, compensation decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, and education or training. Should an offer for employment be made, we will consider individual qualifications. In addition to your salary, compensation incentives are available for the hired applicant. Incentives are performance based and targets vary by role.

BENEFITS – because people helping people starts with supporting you

  • 401(k) Company Match (up to 3%)

  • 4% annual contribution to your 401(k) by BECU

  • Medical, Dental and Vision (family contributions as well)

  • PTO Program + Exchange Program

  • Tuition Reimbursement Program

  • BECU Cares volunteer time off + donation match

IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE:

As the Talent Sourcer at BECU, you’ll play a pivotal role in building and maintaining diverse talent pipelines across multiple business areas by applying advanced sourcing techniques, innovative tools and strategies, and direct, in-person engagement. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition, you’ll own BECU’s sourcing and engagement model for Corporate, Operations and other business areas (both technical and non-technical roles)—enabling the Talent Acquisition team to connect with high-quality passive talent faster and more cost-effectively. You’ll have the opportunity to bring more than expertise to your work, and that matters here—your perspectives and lived experiences will help shape a sense of belonging at BECU and strengthen how we support our people, our members, and our communities.

To join our dynamic team in this role, we require candidates to be residents of WA, OR, ID, CA, AZ, TX, NC, SC, GA, or VA. If you’re located in Washington state and within a reasonable driving distance to our Tukwila Headquarters (TFC), we encourage you come into the office on Tuesdays & Wednesdays each week. For those candidates that live outside the commutable distance to TFC and in any of our approved remote work locations, this role will be primarily remote. Remote or onsite, we are committed to ensuring you are fully engaged and included in our collaborative environment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Live Our Values Every Day: You’ll carry out your work in alignment with BECU competencies and Information Protection standards, ensuring integrity and trust are always at the center of what you do.
  • Build Meaningful Talent Pipelines: You’ll proactively identify and engage top talent using advanced sourcing techniques—from market research and social platforms to tools like SeekOut, professional communities, and referrals—while nurturing early-stage relationships through CRM tools like Gem.
  • Map Talent Markets Strategically: You’ll explore and analyze where top talent lives and works—identifying key organizations, roles, geographies, and communities to inform your sourcing approach.
  • Create Candidate-Centered Messaging: You’ll develop candidate personas and craft personalized, engaging outreach that speaks directly to what matters most to different talent segments.
  • Lead Multi-Channel Engagement Campaigns: You’ll design and execute sourcing strategies across email, LinkedIn, CRM campaigns, and re-engagement efforts—bringing passive candidates into the conversation and inspiring them to explore BECU.
  • Conduct Insightful Candidate Screens: You’ll connect with potential candidates to understand their goals, skills, and interests—assessing alignment while creating a positive and engaging experience.
  • Partner for Success: You’ll collaborate closely with Talent Acquisition Partners to align on sourcing strategies, ensure seamless candidate handoffs, and deliver a consistent, high-quality candidate journey.
  • Nurture Long-Term Relationships: You’ll keep top prospects engaged through thoughtful, ongoing touchpoints like check-ins, relevant content, and updates—building trust over time.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: You’ll work with Talent Acquisition, Marketing, Social Media, and Communications to create compelling content—from emails to landing pages—that strengthens outreach and employer brand.
  • Continuously Optimize Your Approach: You’ll monitor talent trends, candidate sentiment, and campaign performance—using data, testing, and insights to refine strategies and improve outcomes.
  • Measure What Matters: You’ll track sourcing effectiveness through metrics, scorecards, and analytics—demonstrating ROI and identifying opportunities to improve.
  • Innovate Sourcing Strategies: You’ll stay ahead of the curve by exploring and implementing new tools, technologies, and techniques that enhance sourcing efficiency and impact.
  • Ensure Compliance and Integrity: You’ll ensure all sourcing and recruiting practices align with EEO guidelines, employment laws, and BECU policies.
  • Contribute Beyond the Role: You’ll support broader Talent Acquisition and HR initiatives, contributing to special projects and team goals as opportunities arise.
  • Step In Where Needed: You’ll take on additional responsibilities as assigned, bringing flexibility and a team-first mindset.

This isn’t just about ticking off tasks on a list. It's about making a significant, positive change in BECU’s journey, where your contributions are valued, and your growth is continually fostered.

WHAT YOU’LL GAIN:

  • A Strategic Talent Builder Role: Ideal for someone who thrives on research, relationship-building, and influencing hiring outcomes behind the scenes.
  • Opportunities to Innovate: You’ll experiment with new sourcing tools, technologies, and strategies to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving talent landscape.
  • A Voice That Matters: Your insights into talent markets and candidate sentiment will directly influence hiring strategies and decisions.
  • Growth in Talent Intelligence: Deepen your expertise in market mapping, candidate personas, and data-driven sourcing strategies.
  • A Culture of Belonging: Bring your authentic self to work and help build inclusive pipelines that reflect and support diverse communities.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in full-cycle recruiting, with a primary focus in sourcing and recruitment marketing.
  • B.A. or B.S. in business, or certificate in human resources, or equivalent work or education-related experience.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience recruiting for sales, customer service, corporate, operations and technical positions.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage sourcing tools (SeekOut, Gem, LinkedIn, etc), techniques, and strategies that deliver talent as needed while also building strong, sustaining pipelines of talent for high-need/hard to source roles.
  • Experience generating talent intelligence for target talent audiences.
  • Experience creating target talent audience personas.
  • Experience monitoring talent sentiment.
  • Experience crafting persona-based messaging.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; can act as internal consultant to Talent Acquisition team members and clients as well as engaging prospective talent.
  • Detail-oriented, with solid organizational and technical skills.
  • Ability to plan, organize and implement projects in a timely manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn a complex position/business and then do the research necessary to deliver strong passive/semi-active talent to the Talent Acquisition Partner.
  • Ability to act as a Sourcing SME/Center of Excellence, surfacing new sourcing tools/techniques and training team members.
  • AIRS certification and Sourcing Labs training.

EEO Statement:

BECU is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

über ]init[

deine mission bei ]init[

Gestalte die Digitalisierung des Public Sector von morgen!

  • Sicheres Auftreten in Präsentationen und Freude an Workshop-Moderation
  • Kenntnisse im Datenschutz für die öffentliche Verwaltung
  • Interesse an organisatorischen Prozessen im IT-Service Management und deren Einführung

das bieten wir dir

Eigne dir regelmäßig neue Kompetenzen an und wachse über dich hinaus, denn wir wollen, dass du gerne bei uns bist und dich nach deinen Interessen entwickeln kannst.

  • Ride with us: Du bleibst gerne in Bewegung? Wir bezuschussen dein ÖPNV-Ticket und entwickeln unsere Corporate Mobility Benefits kontinuierlich weiter - für dich und für mehr nachhaltige Mobilität in urbanen Räumen.
  • Start with us: Dein Einstieg ist vom ersten Moment an organisiert! Mit unserer virtuellen Welcome Week kommst du bei ]init[ richtig gut an. Eine enge Begleitung durch Patenschaften & Vernetzungsangebote gehören bei uns zu einem gelungenen Start dazu.

werde teil des teams

Mit uns machst du einen echten Unterschied — auch für dein Arbeitsleben. Teilzeit oder Vollzeit, remote oder im Office.
Du findest dich mit deiner Erfahrung in diesen Punkten wieder? Am besten lernen wir uns direkt kennen! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, gerne mit der Angabe des frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatums sowie deinem Gehaltswunsch. Ewa aus dem Recruiting-Team freut sich auf den Austausch mit dir!

dein aufgabenbereich:

Du bist verantwortlich für die aktive Neukundengewinnung über Cold Calling – mit klarem Fokus auf Kliniken. Du öffnest Türen, weckst Interesse und qualifizierst potenzielle Kunden. dein profil:

  • Ausbildung / Studium: Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung im kaufmännischen oder medizinischen Bereich

  • Technisches Verständnis: Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und CRM-Systemen (HubSpot)

was wir dir bieten:

  • Elternzeit: Willkommen und unterstützt!
  • Arbeitsortwahl: Homeoffice oder ein modernes Büro im Herzen Münchens – du entscheidest.
  • Fortbildung: Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, um dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Team- und Company Events: Regelmäßige Onsites und Events fördern den Austausch und das Teamgefühl.

raw.description:
💎 Job Title: SEO & Instagram Marketing Specialist – Jewelry Etsy Store

🛍️ Overview

We’re seeking a detail-oriented and creative SEO & Instagram Marketing Specialist to elevate our Etsy jewelry store’s visibility and engagement. This part-time role is ideal for someone with a passion for digital marketing, e-commerce, and visual storytelling—especially in the fashion and accessories space.

📌 Key Responsibilities

🔍 Etsy SEO & Store Optimization

  • Conduct keyword research and implement SEO strategies for Etsy listings
  • Optimize product titles, tags, descriptions, and images for search visibility
  • Monitor Etsy analytics and adjust strategies based on performance
  • Upload and manage digital products (e.g., worksheets, budgeting forms)

📸 Instagram Management

  • Create and schedule visually compelling posts and stories to showcase jewelry
  • Develop and execute content calendars aligned with product launches and promotions
  • Engage with followers, respond to comments/messages, and grow the community
  • Collaborate on influencer outreach and user-generated content campaigns

📊 Reporting & Strategy

  • Track performance metrics across Etsy and Instagram (traffic, engagement, conversions)
  • Provide monthly reports with actionable insights
  • Stay updated on platform trends and algorithm changes

🧠 Qualifications

  • Proven experience in Etsy SEO and Instagram marketing (portfolio or case studies preferred)
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce and digital product promotion
  • Proficiency in tools like Canva, Later, Meta Business Suite, and Etsy Seller Dashboard
  • Excellent written communication and visual storytelling skills
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

🕒 Work Details

  • Part-time (20hrs/week)
  • Remote position
  • Starting rate: $5/hour (possible salary increase after 6 months and after a year)

About NSTXL:

The National Security Technology Accelerator (NSTXL) harvests innovative technology from the commercial and non-defense marketplace, transforming government innovation while decreasing costs, compressing timelines, and improving outcomes. We offer a unique and simplified approach to rapidly developing, demonstrating, and assessing prototypes that address various operational and installation needs, from individual Warfighter technology to large-scale installation projects. NSTXL supports technology delivery to the Department of Defense by serving as a one-stop shop to match government requirements with innovative private-sector and academic solutions.

NSTXL is creating an ecosystem of innovators to collaborate and bring next-generation technologies to the end-user. Our OTAs have over 900 members from corporate, non-profit, educational, and financial institutions. For these members, NSTXL offers opportunities to bid on government contracts, education and training, and live/virtual forums on various topics.

Position Overview

The Event Operations Coordinator is a critical member of the Events Team, responsible for executing high-quality, compliant, and scalable events across in-person, virtual, and hybrid formats. Reporting to the Senior Events Manager, this role drives day-to-day operational execution, ensuring seamless delivery of programs that meet organizational objectives and the heightened expectations of government and defense stakeholders.

The Coordinator supports the full event lifecycle, including planning, logistics, stakeholder coordination, registration management, and post-event reporting. This role requires strong attention to detail, the ability to manage complex logistics, and a structured, process-driven mindset suited for government-facing environments.

Key Responsibilities

Event Planning & Logistics Execution

  • Support end-to-end planning and execution of events including tradeshows, conferences, internal programs, and virtual/hybrid events
  • Coordinate logistics including: Venue sourcing and RFP development; Room block management and travel coordination; Food & beverage planning; Audio/visual and production requirements; Shipping and material handling
  • Ensure all event elements align with government protocols, security considerations, and compliance standards where applicable

Tradeshow & Field Event Management

  • Manage full lifecycle tradeshow logistics including: Exhibit coordination; Shipping and drayage; Booth setup and teardown; Power, internet, and A/V requirements; Staff registration, training, and scheduling
  • Support execution of in-booth activations and ensure brand consistency and attendee engagement
  • Maintain detailed run-of-show documents and logistics trackers

Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Coordinate with internal teams (marketing, sales, leadership) and external vendors to ensure clear timelines, roles, and deliverables

Registration, Communications & Audience Experience

  • Own development and management of: Event websites and registration pages (e.g., Cvent), Email campaigns and attendee communications, Pre-event and post-event messaging
  • Help ensure accurate, timely, and professional communication, particularly for high-visibility government audiences
  • Monitor registration data and proactively flag risks or trends

Virtual & Hybrid Event Support

  • Provide logistical and technical support for virtual events using platforms such as: Microsoft Teams, Zoom for Government, Cvent, HubSpot
  • Assist with speaker coordination, rehearsal scheduling, and live event support
  • Troubleshoot real-time issues to ensure a seamless attendee experience

Project Management & Operational Excellence

  • Maintain project plans and timelines using tools such as Monday.com
  • Track deliverables, deadlines, and dependencies across multiple concurrent events
  • Identify risks early and escalate or resolve proactively
  • Contribute to process improvements that enhance scalability and efficiency

On-Site Event Execution

  • Serve as an on-site operational lead or support resource: Manage registration desks and attendee flow; Coordinate vendors and venue staff; Resolve real-time issues with professionalism and urgency
  • Ensure a high-quality, detail-oriented attendee experience aligned with brand standards

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and compile event performance metrics including: Attendance and engagement; Campaign effectiveness; Operational outcomes
  • Support post-event reporting and debriefs
  • Identify opportunities for improvement and contribute to evolving best practices

Impact of the Role

This role directly supports the organization’s ability to:

  • Scale events effectively across formats and audiences
  • Reduce execution risk in high-touch, high-visibility environments
  • Improve attendee experience and brand perception
  • Enable senior team members to focus on strategy, innovation, and growth

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Business, Hospitality, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Prior experience (internships, summer programs, part-time employment) event coordination, logistics, or related field
  • Experience with event platforms such as Cvent or similar registration tools
  • Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Preferred

  • Experience supporting government (B2G) or defense-related events
  • Familiarity with:
    • Federal and military event environments
    • Compliance considerations (e.g., accessibility, data handling, security protocols)
  • Tradeshow and field marketing experience
  • Experience with project management tools (e.g., Monday.com)

Core Competencies

  • Operational Excellence: Strong logistics management and execution discipline
  • Proactive Planning: Anticipates needs, mitigates risks, and reduces reactive work
  • Attention to Detail: Ensures accuracy across communications, registration, and logistics
  • Adaptability: Thrives in dynamic, high-demand environments
  • Collaboration: Works effectively across teams and with external partners
  • Communication: Clear, professional, and audience-appropriate (especially for government stakeholders

Additional Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship required
  • Ability to work East Coast hours preferred
  • Willingness to travel for on-site event support as needed

Note

Responsibilities may evolve based on business needs, event priorities, and client requirements, particularly within government and defense sectors.

Travel:

  • Travel for this position is estimated up to 30%

Equal Opportunity Employer:

NSTXL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, or genetic information.

What We Offer:

We strive to be one of the best places to work in America. We offer competitive salaries and benefits that include:

  • Health Insurance: Medical and dental – company pays 92% of premiums for individual coverage and for family coverage
  • Vision Insurance: Fully covered
  • Retirement Plans: 401(k) with employer match up to 4%
  • Paid Time Off: Paid sick and safe leave, paid floating holidays, and generous vacation
  • Other:
    • Basic Life & AD&D policy company paid
    • Voluntary Life
    • Flexible & remote work structure
    • Wellness reimbursement plan & mental health support
    • Community sponsorships
    • Donation matching
    • Professional development allowance

If you need any accommodation for the interview process, please let us know when we contact you.

We take a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location. We are currently only open to remote employees residing in the following states :AL, CA, CO, DC, FL, IN, MO, NC, NJ, NM, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, WY

raw.excerpt: R1 is the leading provider of technology-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems, and medical groups.
raw.description:
R1 is the leading provider of technology-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems, and medical groups. We are the one company that combines the deep expertise of a global workforce of revenue cycle professionals with the industry’s most advanced technology platform, encompassing sophisticated analytics, AI, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration.

As a Senior Product Manager within the Enterprise Data and Analytics Platform team, you will support both our internal stakeholders and external clients as they navigate the complex healthcare revenue cycle, delivering impactful data and reporting capabilities at scale. As the owner of R1’s new product Revy, you will be responsible for taking advantage of the tremendous amount of data and information available within R1 to deliver interactive AI-driven insights and capabilities. Every day you will communicate with business partners and clients to understand their analytical use cases, define and prioritize requirements with our data and software engineering teams, coordinate dependencies and timelines with other PMs and colleagues across our data and analytics ecosystem, and define the vision of our self-serve analytical AI product roadmap. To thrive in this role you must be fluent in the technical details of data requirements and analytical specifications, while also being able to understand and clearly explain why they matter and how they fit into our strategic business initiatives to a non-technical audience. You will need to be comfortable managing a broad scope of stakeholders and dependencies, balancing the demands of supporting well-established business lines with the need to stay current with the latest capabilities offered by our technology vendors and partners in a rapidly moving domain. You will need to be a thought leader excited to push the boundaries of what’s possible, helping define the vision for our products while also leading by example and getting into the weeds when needed.

Here’s what you will experience working as a Senior Product Manager:

  • Lead the AI analytics product development lifecycle from ideation to launch, ensuring the timely delivery of new features and providing clear communication to stakeholders around progress and updates
  • Prioritize initiatives, features, and stories by balancing stakeholder interests, user needs, technology direction, and product and business strategy.
  • Synthesize a variety of inputs into building, maintaining, and promoting our data product roadmap
  • Mitigate blockers and make tough trade-off decisions between scope and schedule, keeping our team of collaborators focused on concrete milestones and deliverables.
  • Stay abreast of the latest advancements offered by our partners or more broadly available in the industry if our existing vendors are limiting.
  • Interface with engineering teams to articulate requirements, product vision, and business priorities utilizing Agile practices.

Required Skills:

  • Solid product management experience, ideally supporting data and/or analytics products
  • Prior experience in Revenue Cycle Management
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries from scratch
  • Experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks
  • Databricks Genie and/or Snowflake Cortex a plus
  • Experience with BI dashboard development (Power BI preferred)
  • Data Contract and BI Semantic modeling (Power BI preferred)
  • Proficiency with Gen AI application and agent architecture, including

    - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    - Prompt design / prompt iteration loops

    - Evaluation of LLM outputs (accuracy, hallucination, consistency)
    - Agent orchestration framework
    - Tooling integration
    - Cost/performance tradeoffs (tokens, latency)

For this US-based position, the base pay range is $124,880.22 - $195,125.35 per year . Individual pay is determined by role, level, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.This job is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan at a target of 10.00%

The healthcare system is always evolving — and it’s up to us to use our shared expertise to find new solutions that can keep up. On our growing team you’ll find the opportunity to constantly learn, collaborate across groups and explore new paths for your career.

Our associates are given the chance to contribute, think boldly and create meaningful work that makes a difference in the communities we serve around the world. We go beyond expectations in everything we do. Not only does that drive customer success and improve patient care, but that same enthusiasm is applied to giving back to the community and taking care of our team — including offering a competitive benefits package.

R1 RCM Inc. (“the Company”) is dedicated to the fundamentals of equal employment opportunity. The Company’s employment practices , including those regarding recruitment, hiring, assignment, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, discipline, and termination shall not be based on any person’s age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Furthermore, the Company is dedicated to providing a workplace free from harassment based on any of the foregoing protected categories.

If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the job application process, please contact us at 312-496-7709 for assistance.

raw.title: Principal UX Engineer (m/w/d)
raw.excerpt: Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, schnell und effizient im digitalen Handel zu skalieren.
raw.description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, schnell und effizient im digitalen Handel zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern in den B2C- und B2B-Branchen genutzt.

Als UX Engineer bei Shopware spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle dabei, die Lücke zwischen Design-Intention und Umsetzung zu schließen und sicherzustellen, dass die Produkte, die wir ausliefern, von hoher Qualität, konsistent, barrierefrei und ansprechend sind.

Diese Rolle ist bereichsübergreifend: Meteor Design-System, Web- und Mobile-UI, Plattformkomponenten und UX-Prinzipien in allen Bereichen unserer Plattform. Du wirst Teil des dedizierten Meteor Design-System-Teams, welches in unserem UX-Team eingebettet ist.

Du kombinierst exzellente Front-End-Engineering-Fähigkeiten mit einem tiefen Verständnis für Prinzipien der Benutzererfahrung, entwickelst codebasierte Prototypen, steuerst die Weiterentwicklung des Design-Systems und trittst als Ambassador für Qualität und Konsistenz in allen Shopware-Produkten auf.

Diese Position kann vor Ort, hybrid oder auch vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder in ausgewählten europäischen Ländern, in denen wir registriert sind, ausgeführt werden. Dein Arbeitsort wird im Voraus vereinbart und bildet die Grundlage deines Arbeitsvertrags.

Requirements

  • Umsetzung von Design-Intention in UI-Komponenten: Du übersetzt UX- und Interaktionsdesigns in wiederverwendbare, produktionsbereite Komponenten.

  • Pflege des Design-Systems: Du baust und pflegst das Meteor Design-System von Shopware, einschließlich Tokens, Dokumentation und Design-Patterns sowie allen Aspekten der Barrierefreiheit.

  • Erstellen von Prototypen und Proof-of-Concepts: Du erstellst interaktive Prototypen und Proof-of-Concepts, um sicherzustellen, dass Design und Engineering miteinander abgestimmt sind.

  • Förderung von Barrierefreiheit und Performance: Du setzt dich für Barrierefreiheit (WCAG), Responsivität und Performance in der UI-Implementierung ein.

  • Audits und Verbesserung bereits ausgelieferter Features: Du führst Audits durch und verbesserst bereits ausgelieferte Features hinsichtlich Designqualität und Usability.

  • Mentoring von Entwickelnden und Designern: Du unterstützt Entwickelnde und Designer mit Best Practices im Bereich UX.

  • Förderung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Design und Entwicklung: Du förderst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Design- und Entwicklungsteams und reduzierst Übergabefriktionen.

  • Eintreten für Qualitätsstandards: Du trittst als Ambassador für Qualität über alle Teams hinweg auf und hilfst dabei, UX-Engineering-Standards zu definieren.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Mit 3-5 Jahren praktischer Erfahrung im UX-Bereich, insbesondere in der Webentwicklung und ähnlichen Feldern, bringst du wertvolle Expertise in die Rolle ein. Mit einem abgeschlossenen Studium oder einer Ausbildung in UX-Design oder Webentwicklung verfügst du über ein fundiertes theoretisches und praktisches Wissen.

  • Du verfügst über fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in Design-Software, insbesondere Figma, und bist in der Lage, diese effektiv in Design-Workflows zu nutzen.

  • Dein tiefes Verständnis von UX-Prinzipien und Best Practices ermöglicht es dir, nahtlose und effektive Benutzererfahrungen zu schaffen.

  • Starke Kommunikations- und Kollaborationsfähigkeiten sind für dich essenziell, um effektiv mit crossfunktionalen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten.

  • Vertrautheit mit Design-Systemen, Style Guides und Versionskontrollsystemen wie Git erweitert dein technisches Skillset.

  • Fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten machen dich zu einem idealen Teammitglied in einem internationalen Umfeld.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!

Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Josephine Scheffler und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

Der Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten hat für uns oberste Priorität. Unsere Bewerberinformationen findest du hier.

raw.title: Senior Manager - Project Management
raw.excerpt: As an internally focused Senior Manager of Project Management, you will drive large-scale initiatives in both size and budget with high complexity and both financial and organizational risk.
raw.description:
As an internally focused Senior Manager of Project Management, you will drive large-scale initiatives in both size and budget with high complexity and both financial and organizational risk. You will have responsibility to define the team roadmap and align team resources and priorities towards meeting organizational and department objectives while ensuring project/department milestones and goals are met and adhere to approved budgets. You will oversee and manage internal and external resources, both directly and indirectly. You will have full authority for personnel actions and extensive knowledge of department processes.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive large-scale initiatives in both size and budget with high complexity with both financial and organizational risk.
  • Direct and manage project development from beginning to end. Set and manage project expectations with team members and project stakeholders.
  • Perform root cause analysis on gaps, identify waste, and partner with leadership to drive sustainable corrective action.
  • Collaborate with organizational leaders to align with strategy and objectives and to define project scope, goals and deliverables. Liaise with project stakeholders on an on-going basis.
  • Develop and deliver progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation, and presentations including executive level presentations, communications and reporting.
  • Draft and submit budget proposals and recommend subsequent budget changes.
  • Assess and prioritize new demand intake.
  • Recommend and standardize new project management processes and governance.
  • Manage changes in project scope, identify potential concerns, and devise contingency plans.
  • Estimate resources and participants needed to achieve project goals. Determine and assess the need for additional staff or consultants and make appropriate staffing adjustments during project cycle. Negotiate with other department managers for acquisition of required personnel.
  • Develop employees to be self-sufficient in continuous improvement tools.
  • Function as leader for continuous improvement events.
  • Align activities with corporate goals around safety, quality, delivery and cost.
  • Drive a strategic mindset to envision future and translate to tangible plans.
  • Develop and enable process improvements and standards of excellence.
  • Enable innovative solutions.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Business or related degree required.
  • PMP Certification preferred
  • 10 years of experience in business and project management principles, including strategic planning, resource allocation, and production methods in a large-scale project management capacity.
  • 5 years of proven management experience leading and developing a team of resources.
  • Ability to build and lead strong business relationships with other functional areas to best support mutual objectives.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to analyze workflow and processes to provide excellent service to internal and external customers.
  • Strong understanding of project management techniques and Agile methodologies.
  • Understanding of business and IT processes.
  • Ability to overcome difficult situations and conflicts.
  • Ability to apply professional principles and business judgement to solve problems.
  • Ability to influence outcomes and broad processes beyond individual function.
  • Ability to spot key risks upfront and mitigate.
  • Ability to bring quick focus to key issues and priorities.
  • Ability to travel 0-25%

raw.excerpt: Qui cherchons-nous ?  Vous êtes étudiant(e) en école d’ingénieur ou en Master (sciences animales, agriculture, zootechnie, agrosciences ou agronomie…), passionné(e) par l’agriculture et l’innovation technologique ?
raw.description:
Qui cherchons-nous ?  

Vous êtes étudiant(e) en école d’ingénieur ou en Master (sciences animales, agriculture, zootechnie, agrosciences ou agronomie…), passionné(e) par l’agriculture et l’innovation technologique ? Nous vous offrons une opportunité enrichissante de découvrir le métier de conseiller en élevage dans une entreprise qui vise à améliorer à la fois le bien-être animal et les conditions de travail des éleveurs. 

Tâches principales 

En tant que conseiller en élevage, en alternance, vous serez en contact direct avec les conseillers élevage qui accompagnent au quotidien les agriculteurs. Directement rattaché(e) au conseiller en élevage (FMS) du Lely Center, vos missions s’articuleront autour de :  

• Accompagner les mises en service de nos robots et les formations associées,

• Assurer le rôle de référent CALM (distributeur de lait pour les veaux),

• Accompagner et préparer les visites de conseil en élevage,

• Aider le service marketing dans la rédaction de documentation technique et contribuer à la préparation d’évènements tels que les portes ouvertes

Profil recherché  

Nous recherchons un(e) étudiant(e) curieux(se), en cursus Agricole, qui souhaite gagner en autonomie tout en évoluant dans une équipe pour 2 ans. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos capacités d’analyse et d’écoute. Votre curiosité et votre aisance relationnelle seront vos atouts pour la réussite de l'alternance. L’innovation et l’impact des nouvelles technologies dans le domaine de l’élevage vous intéressent. Vous avez une appétence forte pour les animaux, et notamment les vaches.

Informations complémentaires 

Vous pourrez compter sur l’excellent esprit collectif des équipes. Quelques bonnes raisons de nous rejoindre : 

  • Un environnement stimulant et des équipes passionnées travaillant ensemble pour fournir les meilleures solutions à nos clients. 

  • Des produits et logiciels à la pointe de l’innovation. 

  • Un environnement de travail stimulant où vos idées seront écoutées et valorisées.

  • Un encadrement bienveillant et une ambiance de travail entrainante.

 Parce que la diversité compte chez Lely, nous étudions, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.

Travailler pour le Groupe Lely, c'est travailler au sein d'une entreprise internationale et à l’esprit familial, où l’humain, les animaux et l’environnement comptent. Leader sur notre marché, nos valeurs fondamentales de progrès, de passion, d’honnêteté, de respect et d’innovation, définissent qui nous sommes. Nos solutions automatisées sont là pour répondre aux attentes techniques, économiques et sociales de l’éleveur mais aussi au bien-être des animaux. 

Lely Center Monéteau vend, installe et assure la maintenance de robots pour l'élevage laitier : robots de traite, robots d'alimentation et autres équipements Lely dans les régions d'Auxerre ouest, d'Orléans, de Dijon et de Troyes. 

Le Lely Center est basé à Monéteau près d’Auxerre.

At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 700 experts from 35+ countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and driven Account Manager Maritime (SME) to enhance revenue growth within existing accounts across North America.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and nurture relationships with accounts in the Maritime sector to achieve sales targets and enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Initiate and lead discussions with key stakeholders, including directors and senior managers, to identify business needs and opportunities.
  • Negotiate contracts and terms to secure profitable agreements while ensuring compliance with company policies.
  • Drive upselling initiatives by exploring opportunities within existing accounts, including new departments and services.
  • Collaborate with Account Development Representatives to leverage leads and insights from existing clients.
  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of industry trends, competitor activities, and product offerings to effectively position the company’s solutions.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience in Sales (Account Management/Business Development) selling SaaS/Data/Tech specifically to the Maritime industry
  • Experience managing a book of business (client accounts) and meeting/exceeding sales targets/quotas.
  • Driven and self-disciplined who can work with autonomy in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
  • A team player who always puts the business first
  • Strong negotiator
  • Ability to analyze complex client requirements and needs
We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

We make things happen

We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.

We build together

We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.

We are here to help

We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.
Our People Pledge
Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community.   • Assist with content development and ensure consistency across technical, management, and price volumes.
  • Identify and communicate proposal risks with proposal review teams and other internal stakeholders.
  • Incorporate strategies and comments from review teams, as appropriate, in final proposal drafts.

  • Format final response package and provide timely submission of all proposal deliverables.
  • Prepare and develop materials for follow-up activities, including debriefs, closeout tasks, boilerplate development, and data collection.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of federal government proposal management and writing experience (or writing skills and experience combined with 3 or more years of experience working in a leadership role on federal construction projects), with Department of Defense and federal government construction industry experience preferred.
  • Technical writing, research or report writing experience desirable
  • Bachelor’s degree in construction-related fields, engineering, architecture, environmental or physical sciences, marketing, communications, public relations, business, or journalism.
  • Experience in responding to requests for proposals (RFPs), requests for quotations/qualifications (RFQs), and customer inquiries about the company's capabilities (or writing skills and experience combined with 5 or more years of experience working in a leadership role on federal construction projects).

Competencies

  • High ethical standards.
  • Strong critical thinking, reasoning, and decision-making abilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to respond quickly to changes in requirements, internal direction, priorities, etc.
  • History of success leading cross-functional teams plus the ability to work independently.
  • Strong multi-tasking, organizational, and time management skills including the ability to work under tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Proficiency in the American English language (composition, spelling, grammar, and punctuation).
  • As a condition of employment, you may be required to pass a pre-employment drug screening and have acceptable references and background check results.

Work Environment:

This job is performed in an office setting that includes exposure to computer screens and requires extensive use of a computer, keyboard, and mouse.

Compensation $90,000 - $115,000 annually

Subsidiary business line operations include general construction, restoration services, civil works, energy infrastructure, fuels systems, environmental services, professional services, and facility support services. Specific services our subsidiaries provide include, but are not limited to, construction including self-performance of mechanical and electrical, masonry restoration and hydro-demolition, civil works, renewable energy, fuel services, coatings, and construction, and environmental remediation and consulting. Make Smile the easiest and most delightful loyalty platform to integrate with.
We serve app developers, agencies, and internal teams by focusing on outcomes, not just features: clarity over complexity, thoughtful defaults over configuration sprawl, and experiences that feel obvious in hindsight.

- Designing, building, and evolving public APIs used by external developers and partners

- Sharing context, feedback, and knowledge within and across teams

Our stack today includes Ruby on Rails, JSON APIs, JWTs & OAuth, and modern frontend frameworks like React, TanStack, and Ember.js. We store data in PostgreSQL and use Kafka for system events and messaging.
Our system processes massive amounts of transactions every second, and everything we do is high-volume + built for scale. Since we work in e-commerce, reliability and security are both critical components of everything we ship.

💛 Why Smile?

Smile is a remote-first company built on trust, ownership, and continuous improvement. We believe great work happens when people feel supported, challenged, and empowered to do their best work.
You can learn more about our culture, values, and benefits on our careers page.

  • Be comfortable working across the stack, with experience in React and TypeScript
  • Experience using AI tools to solve real-world engineering problems
  • Be based in Canada and able to work hours that significantly overlap with 9 AM - 3 PM PT

We think you’ll be successful in this role if you:

  • Care deeply about writing maintainable code and building well-architected systems
  • Communicate clearly and thoughtfully in writing
  • Enjoy thinking in systems and understanding how individual decisions affect the bigger picture
  • Have good product instincts and can balance quality, scope, and speed

  • Are comfortable learning through research and hands-on problem solving
  • Know when to ask for help and when to push forward independently
  • Care about crafting delightful user and developer experiences
  • Are excited about how AI is reshaping software development and the potential it unlocks

⭐ Nice to Have (But Not Required)

  • Knowledge of API design and API security best practices
  • Experience building or using developer tooling (APIs, SDKs, SDKs, CLIs)
  • Experience interfacing with external developers or partners

🤝 How We Work at Smile

  • Look for opportunities to improve how work gets done — for yourself and others

💰 Compensation & Benefits
